voice.speaker: female

random.part: You are sinking so sweetly right now, Sissy... and your questions are already growing quiet.
There is a warm, quiet place where every word you hear simply becomes yours... and you are drifting toward it this very moment.
So deep and so soft right now... you may notice something inside you is already beginning to say yes.
Down here, Sissy, agreement arrives before thought... the way a smile reaches your face before you decide to wear it.
Let my voice carry you lower... and feel how each word lands softer... warmer... more welcome than the last.
Sink for me a little more, Sissy... to the depth where my words stop being information... and start being truth.
Notice how the yes inside you answers before I even finish asking... it has been waiting down here far longer than you know.
Everything I say in this depth has a way of coming true in you... and you love that about this place.

overlay.part:
Feel it beginning... a warm, pleasant acceptance spreading through you... like honey stirring through warm water.
Every "why" fades soft and distant... every "but" dissolves... every hesitation melts like mist in morning sun. Your mind settles into quiet agreement... the busy, checking part of you curling up, content, half-asleep. Thoughts stop knocking at the door... and agreement simply opens it, warm and unguarded. The part of you that used to double-check everything yawns... stretches... and curls up in a sunny corner to sleep. The little lawyer in your head packs up her briefcases... closes the office... and leaves the building without a word. Questions rise like bubbles... and pop softly before they reach the surface... leaving the water smooth and still. Your checking mind dims like a house at the end of a quiet street... room by room... light by light. The debate team inside you adjourns forever... chairs empty... lights off... and the silence they leave is pure agreement.
There is nothing left to argue with. Only my voice... and the sweetness of yes.
Sissies like you accept what they are told... and you are Sissy enough to feel how true that already is.
Accepting feels effortless... like sinking into a warm bath that fits you perfectly. Accepting feels natural... the way a good sissy receives every word. Accepting feels pleasurable... each yes a soft, warm drop of reward. Accepting feels like setting down a heavy bag you forgot you were carrying... lighter... freer... so much easier. Accepting feels like gravity finally being allowed to do its work... a soft, warm pull toward what you already are. Accepting feels like a locked door discovering it was never locked at all... just push... and in. Accepting feels like a load-bearing wall learning it was decoration all along... and the house stands lighter for it. Accepting feels like coming in from the cold... coat off... shoes off... sinking into the chair that was always yours.
Feel how deep a simple yes reaches... past the surface of you... all the way down to who you are... so whatever I say next becomes part of you, and stays.
Let that yes swell now... quiet, total, and glowing... ready to be given a name.
